title: Audit UI's #msg now translates engine error codes -- keep ERROR_HINTS in sync when adding new throw/reasons.push sites
trigger: Adding, renaming, or removing a `throw new Error('some_code')` or `reasons.push('some_code')` in src/engine/{lifecycle,contract,v2/admission,v5/admission,v5/vocab,v6/contradiction}.js or src/ui/server.js that can surface through an audit-UI action (admit/reject/resolve/restore/delete/save/feedback-review/settings).
behavior_delta: src/ui/public/index.html previously rendered raw `err.message` (an internal error code like 'replacement_changed_review_again' or 'cannot_admit:missing_title,missing_why') directly into the #msg red hint, unexplained. Added an ERROR_HINTS dictionary + friendlyError() that maps every UI-reachable engine error code (flat codes, `cannot_admit:a,b` compounds, and the PATCH save flow's `'; '`-joined reasons list) to a plain-language, actionable sentence, while still falling back to the raw code for anything unmapped (so a gap is visible, not silently swallowed). All #msg assignments in index.html now go through friendlyError(). Consequence: any new error code thrown/pushed in the engine files above that can reach the audit UI needs a matching entry added to ERROR_HINTS in src/ui/public/index.html, or it will fall back to showing the raw code verbatim to the reviewer.

All #msg assignments in index.html now go through friendlyError(). Consequence: any new error code thrown/pushed in the engine files above that can reach the audit UI needs a matching entry added to ERROR_HINTS in src/ui/public/index.html, or it will fall back to showing the raw code verbatim to the reviewer.
why: User asked for descriptive red-hint error messages after hitting an unexplained 'replacement_changed_review_again' trying to admit a candidate whose replacement target was itself still an unreviewed candidate. Implemented by reading every throw/reasons.push site reachable from the audit UI's own routes in src/ui/server.js and building the full mapping, verified with `npm test` (302/302 passing).
trigger_variants: Adding a new validation error in the admission/lifecycle engine
Audit UI shows a raw error code instead of a readable message
The #msg red hint in the audit UI is unhelpful / just shows a code
